ambient_events: A car noses into a bay and the driver sits a minute with the engine off.
Somebody walks the row twice, trying to remember where they parked.
A car door shuts somewhere along the row, and the sound comes back off the Coliseum.
description: Bays lined in white, oil-marked down the middle. Ticket stubs have blown against the kerb and stayed there.
name: Hughson Car Park
